name: put here the your name of the model - it will be used as a name for results, if it is standard use word auto to generate name from dataset params
weights_name: put here the name of the weights - it will be used as a name for results
weights_path: full path to the weights of the model.ckpt file - like this  .../CVM-NET-I_model/model.ckpt
root_dir: put path to the dataset, example: D:/datasets/Warsaw/

dataset.splitfile: put here splitfile path relativle to root_dir or write auto if the params are standard
dataset.angle: put an angle of the images, it can be orto, oblique-north, oblique-south, oblique-east, oblique-west

results.path: put here path where results will be saved, example: C:/Users/masik/Workspace/inzynierka/repos/BEng-MK/results/

accuracy.filename: name of the filename where accuracy will be saved, example: finetune-mix

charts.path: put here path where charts will be saved, example: C:/Users/masik/Workspace/inzynierka/repos/BEng-MK/results/charts/
charts.custom_info: put here custom info for the chart, it will be displayed on the chart, example: Weights taken from the original paper (93% accuracy on reference model top-1%)
